name: Xump - The Final Run
author: Retroguru
description_short: A single-screen puzzle game about clearing dissolving tiles and disarming mines.
description_long: Guide the headbot Xump across 48 single-screen levels, clearing every dissolving tile while avoiding falls and dealing with minefields. The game features nine chiptune tracks, a high-score list, a password system, and hidden themes and classic levels.
